This package is ideal for individuals with

It provides a comprehensive evaluation of
cholesterol levels, inflammation markers, clotting risks, and heart strain indicators

Yes. This package helps identify
silent risk factors

The Thyrocare Jaanch Healthy Heart Basic Package is designed to assess critical parameters associated with cardiovascular health. This package is highly recommended for adults who wish to evaluate their heart health proactively. It is also ideal for those with a family history of heart disease or those undergoing routine wellness screening.

Yes, fasting for 8 to 10 hours is necessary before this test. During the fasting period, only water is permitted. Fasting ensures accurate measurement of glucose and lipid values, which are essential for evaluating cardiovascular risk.

Thyrocare offers free home sample collection across India. After scheduling the test, a trained phlebotomist visits the customer’s home at a chosen time to collect the blood sample using hygienic and standardized procedures. The collected samples are then processed at Thyrocare’s centralized, fully automated lab to ensure high precision and fast report generation.

The Thyrocare Jaanch Healthy Heart Basic Package is priced at Rs 1,250. The cost covers all tests included in the panel, home sample collection, and a detailed digital report sent via SMS and email. It is a cost-effective solution for early heart disease detection and monitoring.

Thyrocare typically delivers the test report within 24 to 48 hours of sample collection. The digital report is sent to the registered mobile number and email, making it easy to share with healthcare professionals for further guidance.

Thyrocare is a pioneer in preventive health checkups with more than two decades of experience in diagnostics. This package includes a wide range of heart-related tests like lipid profile, hs-CRP, homocysteine, apolipoproteins A1 & B, Lp(a), and more to assess comprehensive cardiac risk.

It is ideal for individuals with a family history of heart disease, high cholesterol, diabetes, or those above 40 years of age who want to monitor their heart health in detail.
3. How is the Heart Screen Extended different from Basic and Advanced packages by Thyrocare?
While Basic and Advanced focus on core heart parameters, the Extended package adds deeper markers like Lp(a) and apolipoproteins for a more thorough heart risk assessment.

Yes, fasting for 10–12 hours is recommended to ensure accurate lipid and cardiac test results.

Yes, all tests are processed at NABL-certified Thyrocare labs, ensuring high accuracy and reliability.
9. What is Lp(a) and why is it included in this Thyrocare package?
Lp(a), or Lipoprotein (a), is a genetic risk factor for heart disease. Thyrocare includes it in the Extended package for a detailed cardiovascular risk profile.
